facts.fact: BUNEC's director general says BUNEC is already deploying an inter-administrative platform to link the civil registration system and the national ID system.

CMR.note: No count or share of ID holders stated.
No number at birth stated; civil registration is mostly paper.
No operator stated; ID cards are issued by the General Delegation for National Security.

facts.fact: BUNEC's director general says the civil registration interoperability is expected to extend to the Ministry of Finance for payroll ghost-worker control, and plans links to CNPS and the electoral register.

CMR.note: ID card system not described beyond its issuer.
